name: How long does a primary bathroom remodel usually take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a primary bathroom remodel usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a primary bathroom remodel depends on its complexity. A basic cosmetic update, such as replacing fixtures and painting, might take 2-4 weeks. A more extensive renovation involving demolition, reconfiguring plumbing, electrical work, and custom installations typically requires 6-10 weeks. Factors like material availability, permit approvals, and unexpected discoveries during demolition can influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the design and material selections are finalized.
acceptedAnswer.description: A primary bathroom remodel can take 2-4 weeks for minor updates or 6-10 weeks for extensive renovations, depending on project complexity and material availability.
